press_references.value: Lyft, Uber drivers push for $1.3 billion wage settlement

legal_proceedings.description: Lyft and Uber are involved in a legal proceeding where 5,000 drivers are seeking a $1.3 billion wage settlement for back pay and damages. The settlement talks are in the final stages, with city and state officials intervening on behalf of the drivers.
